title: Why Does a Beaver Move So Differently Near Water?
caption:
A BEAVER'S BODY IS BUILT FOR WATER. Filmed in a zoo. #WildVox #Beavers #AnimalFacts #Nature

narration_timeline.text: This North American beaver was filmed at a zoo, where its heavy body is easy to see.
narration_timeline.scene: North American beaver in Ljubljana zoo shown on or near ground.

narration_timeline.text: On the ground, the animal carries a broad body and stays close to the enclosure.
narration_timeline.scene: Another authentic beaver recording inside zoo enclosure.

narration_timeline.text: When it enters water, that same body is supported as it moves and paddles.
narration_timeline.scene: Two separate genuine clips of beaver water movement at zoo.

narration_timeline.text: A beaver also has dense fur that helps protect it in its watery habitat.
narration_timeline.scene: Beaver in separate close view of its fur and body.

narration_timeline.text: Watch how different the animal can look when it is moving through water.
narration_timeline.scene: Beaver moving through water in different zoo session.

narration_timeline.text: These zoo recordings give a close look at a rodent adapted for life beside water.
narration_timeline.scene: Two beaver sightings in zoo setting near water.
